answer_1.quote: a large vision-language model (VLM) processes single or multiple retrieved document images and not only generates an answer to the user query but also returns the bounding box of the relevant region within the evidence document.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answer and bounding box coordinates for visual source attribution

answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics assessed both generated answers and bounding box predictions. Relaxed exact match (EM) was used to measure generated answer accuracy, considering a generated answer correct if it shares a subsequence relationship with the golden answer and differs by no more than 20 characters. Intersection over Union (IoU) was calculated to determine bounding box precision, with an IoU threshold of 0.5 indicating a correct prediction.
